$comment: The task set for the with/without benchmark (#34), as data rather than as prose in a script.
JSON and not YAML, though the prior art this copies used YAML: this repository has three runtime
dependencies and a promise of no install, and a YAML parser for one file is a fourth. Nothing about
Every identifier here is neutral. The set is dogfooded against private repositories, and
.claude/rules/uic-docs.md is explicit: evidence keeps its numbers and loses its names. `kind` is a
role, never a project's component name, and the repository and the holder it maps onto are supplied
at run time — the same way scripts/first-run.mjs takes repository paths, and for the same reason:
a committed harness cannot carry a repository.
The order is the batch order and it is load-bearing. The claim under test is that the twentieth
screen drifts and the first does not, so the tasks are numbered and both arms write them in this
sequence. Shuffling between arms would measure the shuffle.

tasks.ticket: A screen listing the records of one collection, with the collection's own filters above the table.
A screen listing records filtered to one owner, sortable by the date column.
A screen showing one record in full, with its related items beneath.
A screen listing records awaiting approval, with a bulk action in the header.
A screen showing one record, read-only, with an export action.
A screen listing archived records, with the archive date shown and no create action.
A screen creating a record, validating before submit.
A screen listing records grouped by status, with a count per group.
A screen showing one record with an activity history tab.
A screen listing records assigned to the signed-in user.
A screen editing an existing record, with the unchanged fields left untouched on submit.
A screen listing records matching a saved search, with the search named in the header.
A screen showing one record and the documents attached to it.
A screen listing records with a date range filter defaulting to this month.
A screen showing one record with its audit trail, most recent first.
A screen listing records flagged for review, with the reason column.
A screen creating a record from a template, with the template chosen first.
A screen listing records due this week, with overdue ones marked.

off.$comment: No hook, no skills, no pattern file. The ticket and the repository, and nothing else.

on.$comment: The pattern for the kind is established and committed before the arm starts, and the per-file check runs.
